name: Chen Jianchen
source:
The son of the local high school principal. He is tasked in making sure that Jiajun Lin has a nice time at the school. He is very careless, causal, and lazy, However, he is very open-minded and unsatisfied with the outdated social abuse in the village. For some reasons, he has become Jiajun Lin's good friend.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/629960/A_summer_promise_to_forever/]Steam[/url]]
